Setup a fare structure to calculate the monetary costs of trips

Source: R/fares.R
setup_fare_structure.Rd

Creates a basic fare structure that describes how transit fares should be calculated in travel_time_matrix(), accessibility(), detailed_itineraries() and pareto_frontier(): every route, fare type and transfer costs base_fare (read as a 32-bit float, the type fares are kept in). The structure can then be edited to follow the fare rules of the study area.

Usage

setup_fare_structure(
  network,
  base_fare,
  by = "MODE",
  debug_path = NULL,
  debug_info = NULL
)

Arguments

network

A network built with build_network().

base_fare

A number, at least 0: the fare of every route, type and transfer.

by

A string: one fare type per mode ("MODE", the default), per agency ("AGENCY_ID", or "AGENCY_NAME"), or one type for all routes ("GENERIC").

debug_path, debug_info

A .csv path (or NULL) and one of "MODE", "ROUTE" and "MODE_ROUTE" (or NULL), stored in the structure's debug_settings. No debug file is written whatever they say.

Value

A fare structure (a list, see Details).

Tables are tibbles by default; options(peabiru.output = "data.frame") gives base data.frames and options(peabiru.output = "data.table") gives data.tables (see peabiru-package).

Details

The structure is a list:

  • max_discounted_transfers: most transfers with a discount (default 1).

  • transfer_time_allowance: minutes between the boardings of a discounted transfer (default 120).

  • fare_cap: highest fare of a trip (Inf: no cap).

  • fares_per_type: one row per fare type (type, unlimited_transfers, allow_same_route_transfer, use_route_fare, fare).

  • fares_per_transfer: the fare of two rides together (first_leg, second_leg, fare), for the pairs of types with a discount.

  • fares_per_route: the fare type of each GTFS route (agency_id, agency_name, route_id, route_short_name, route_long_name, mode, route_fare, fare_type), matched by agency_id and route_id.

  • debug_settings: the debug settings (output_file, trip_info).

How the fare of a trip follows from it: the first ride costs its route's fare (the type's fare, or the route's route_fare when the type has use_route_fare); each later ride of the same type as the previous one is free when the type has unlimited_transfers; otherwise, while fewer than max_discounted_transfers discounts were used, a ride boarded within transfer_time_allowance minutes of the previous boarding, with a row of fares_per_transfer for the two types (and not on the same route, unless the type has allow_same_route_transfer) brings the two rides to that row's fare; any other ride costs its full fare. The total is capped at fare_cap. Fare rules of this kind are the ones supported: a structure that names a fare calculator instead (an element type) is an error in the routing functions.

See also

Other fare structure: pareto_frontier(), read_fare_structure(), write_fare_structure()

Examples

data_path <- system.file("extdata/spo", package = "peabiru")
network <- build_network(data_path, n_threads = 2)
fare_structure <- setup_fare_structure(network, base_fare = 4.4)
fare_structure$fares_per_type
#> # A tibble: 3 × 5
#>   type   unlimited_transfers allow_same_route_transfer use_route_fare  fare
#>   <chr>  <lgl>               <lgl>                     <lgl>          <dbl>
#> 1 SUBWAY FALSE               FALSE                     FALSE            4.4
#> 2 BUS    FALSE               FALSE                     FALSE            4.4
#> 3 RAIL   FALSE               FALSE                     FALSE            4.4
